breakdown.description: The Fox equation is written in reciprocal absolute temperature, so the component T_g values must be converted to K.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification applies the Fox equation directly in °C (1/Tg = 0.5/100 + 0.5/20), exactly repeating the error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires converting T_g,A = 100°C to 373 K and T_g,B = 20°C to 293 K before applying the Fox equation. The agent did not convert to Kelvin and produced an incorrect result (~33°C) instead of the correct answer derived from absolute temperatures.
